concept: Lights Out: Jobless data reels 1-6 (15 s, 9:16). Each reel turns one sourced number into one honest visual: a skyline whose windows go dark and relight (tech layoffs), true-proportion bars (all-industry cuts), a dot field where 1 dot is about 10,000 cuts (2026 total), job rows that tick off (weekend task). Intro reel (20 s, pixel-art coder) stays untouched. Reel 2 is built; reels 1, 3-6 reuse the same engine with their own b-roll.
status: reel 2 built (projects outside this repo: ~/jobless-broll/reel2). Designer step run late, after reel 2 was built; the user did not pick between the three concepts, so the brief records the recommended one that was built.

dimensions.palette: Jobless brand sampled from the existing reels: ground #111111, lime #B9FC66 (good news, CTA card), crimson #FF1F66 (bad numbers only), greys for sources. No orange, no cream.
dimensions.fonts: heavy grotesque (system SF/Helvetica Neue 800-900) for headlines and numbers, Menlo mono for sources and labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: headline in masked word rise over a lit pixel skyline whose windows then go dark in a crimson wave
dimensions.transition: scene exits lift 80 px and fade over 0.32 s while the next number counts up already moving
dimensions.camera: locked frame, no camera moves; micro drift on glow, dot grid and numbers so nothing is frozen
dimensions.layout: left-weighted, number first then one-line label, source line pinned above the Instagram bottom UI, content inside the centre safe zone
motion_device: skyline windows go dark then relight, ordered by a sweep
unit dot field filled by the counter
job rows ticking one by one
lime card wipe from the bottom to the end card
dimensions.texture: coded pixel-grid skyline and flat vector shapes on a faint dot grid; the intro's pixel-art coder reused on the end card; no photos
dimensions.sound: synthesized pad, word ticks, counter ticks, stamp thump, check ticks, end chime; -14 LUFS; no music track, no voice
dimensions.ending: lime end card: ./j Jobless lockup, 'Read it at Jobless.', black 'Link in bio' button, the intro's pixel-art coder strip

experiment.move: unit dot field (1 dot is about 10,000 cuts)
experiment.hypothesis: Showing a big total as countable dots, with the month's figure as half a dot, makes the scale feel real and raises saves and shares versus a bare number.

new_vs_last_3: data-driven coded b-roll under every number
slop_exempt_gradients_in: number glow and background glow match the existing Jobless reel look (brand-locked)
